caption: Figure 1. Architecture of Atmosphere. Containers 𝐴and 𝐵are untrusted but can establish communication with a verified container 𝑉. Thread 𝑇1 invokes the send() system call to pass a page to 𝑇2 which is already waiting on the endpoint inside the microkernel.

templates.why_chosen: Medium-confidence, rank-7 exemplar of the horizontal variant: a formally verified container V sits between untrusted peers A and B, all three resting above the microkernel's endpoint data structures in the band below.
templates.what_to_learn: Flank the trusted middle component with its untrusted peers in one row rather than stacking all three, and match send()/recv() call labels on the two boxes that actually interact; the weakness here is that the third peer is drawn but never wired to anything, so give every peer at least one visible arrow.
